steps: Open the map (G) and look for the dirt/tarmac roads linking monuments.
Walk onto any road — barrels often line them, so this usually pops while looting early.
Mine rust-coloured metal ore nodes (common in rocky/mountain areas) until you have 300 ore.
The achievement counts raw ore as you mine it — smelting is optional for the unlock.
Find loot barrels along roads and around monuments.
Break 10 barrels with any tool or weapon, then loot the scrap and components.
Craft a Building Plan and Hammer (default blueprints, wood only).
Place foundations, walls, a doorway and a roof — even a 2x1 with a door and Tool Cupboard counts.
Loot roadside barrels and monument crates, or recycle unwanted components at a recycler (Outpost/Bandit Camp).
Gather 65 scrap total.
Loot barrels/crates for low grade fuel, or craft it from animal fat + cloth.
Hold 50 low grade fuel at once or accumulate the acquire counter to 50.
Equip the Hammer, look at a twig/wood building block, and upgrade it to a higher tier (wood → stone → metal → armoured).
Hit trees with your starting rock (or a Stone Hatchet) until you gather 100 wood.
Aim for the glowing hit marker after the first swing for bonus yield.
Craft a Stone Hatchet, then chop trees until you have collected 700 wood total across your account.
Find a wild horse and mount it (or tame one).
Ride continuously until you cover 1 km — open areas and roads make tracking distance easier.
Find or buy any instrument (often in barrels or vending machines).
Equip it and press a note key to play — the achievement unlocks on first play.
Mine grey stone nodes and pick up loose stones until you have 200 stone.
A Stone Pickaxe roughly doubles gather rate over the starting rock.
Harvest hemp bushes (tall green plants) and skin animals until you have 30 cloth.
Gather Wood, open the crafting menu (TAB).
Craft a Camp Fire — place it to cook food and stay warm.
Gather Wood and Stones from nodes / debris.
Craft a Stone Hatchet for faster wood gathering.
Loot or craft any clothing and fill 3 clothing slots (hat, shirt, pants, etc.).
Craft a Wooden Spear from wood early after spawning.
Use it for hunting and basic melee until you find better weapons.
Kill any animal (chickens/boars are safest early) with a rock or spear.
Craft a Hammer from wood.
Equip it to upgrade, rotate, and repair building blocks.
Craft a Campfire, equip it from inventory, and place it on a flat surface (ideally inside your base).
Craft a Stone Pickaxe from wood + stone.
Mine ore and stone nodes with it.
Craft a Building Plan from wood.
Equip it to place twig foundations, walls, and stairs.
Find scientists at monuments (Military Tunnel, Oil Rig, Launch Site, Outpost, etc.).
Kill 5 scientists total — they are armed NPCs, so bring a gun and meds.
Craft a Sleeping Bag and place it inside a locked room in your base.
This sets your respawn point so you do not beach-respawn after every death.
Keep picking hemp and skinning animals until you reach 50 cloth total.
Harvest hemp plants for Cloth (or recycle clothing).
Craft a Sleeping Bag and place it as your respawn point.

Hidden achievement. Steam does not publish a description for this hidden achievement, so we are not going to guess at the trigger. Check a community guide or the in-game achievement list once it unlocks.
After killing an animal, hold E on the corpse to harvest meat, cloth, and bone.
Craft Wooden Arrows (or better) from the crafting menu.
Place a Wooden Storage Box on a floor inside your base.

Hidden achievement. Steam does not publish a description for this hidden achievement, so we are not going to guess at the trigger. Check a community guide or the in-game achievement list once it unlocks.
Craft a Key Lock (or Code Lock if researched), then place it on a door.
Place a lock on a door/box and lock it (set a code or use the key).
Craft a Wooden Storage Box and place it in your base for loot.
Craft a Key Lock or Code Lock.
Place it on a door or box, then lock it (set a code if using a Code Lock).
Craft a Tool Cupboard (TC) once you have wood + stones.
Place it inside your base and authorize yourself.
Craft a Wooden Door from wood.
Place it into a doorframe and add a lock.
Craft a Hunting Bow from wood + cloth.
Craft Wooden Arrows and hunt animals or players.
Craft a Tool Cupboard, then place it fully inside your base footprint.
Authorize on the TC — anything outside its radius is not protected.
Equip a Wooden Door and place it in a doorway on your base.
Gather the required materials, then open the crafting menu (default TAB).
Craft Burlap Pants and keep it in your inventory or hotbar.
Gather the required materials, then open the crafting menu (default TAB).
Craft Burlap Shirt and keep it in your inventory or hotbar.
Craft or loot Furnace first.
Equip it from the belt/hotbar and place it on a valid surface/frame.
Gather the required materials, then open the crafting menu (default TAB).
Craft Burlap Headwrap and keep it in your inventory or hotbar.

achievements.name: Save The Planet
achievements.description: Recycle 5 empty cans at a recycler

steps: Find and eat Cans of Beans or Tuna to produce empty cans.
Bring 5 empty cans to a recycler at a monument (Outpost, Bandit Camp, Lighthouse, etc.) and recycle them.
Gather the required materials, then open the crafting menu (default TAB).
Craft Furnace and keep it in your inventory or hotbar.
Craft or loot Workbench first.
Equip it from the belt/hotbar and place it on a valid surface/frame.
At a Research Table, research any item you do not already know the blueprint for.
Gather the required materials, then open the crafting menu (default TAB).
Craft Workbench and keep it in your inventory or hotbar.
Craft or loot Research Table first.
Equip it from the belt/hotbar and place it on a valid surface/frame.
Gather the required materials, then open the crafting menu (default TAB).
Craft Machete and keep it in your inventory or hotbar.

achievements.name: I'm the Captain now
achievements.description: Reach the bridge of the Cargo Ship

steps: Board the periodic Cargo Ship event when it spawns.
Fight through scientists to the top bridge area of the ship.
Gather the required materials, then open the crafting menu (default TAB).
Craft Nailgun Nails and keep it in your inventory or hotbar.
Gather the required materials, then open the crafting menu (default TAB).
Craft Research Table and keep it in your inventory or hotbar.

achievements.name: On The Deck
achievements.description: Land a minicopter on an oil rig Helipad

steps: Obtain a Minicopter (usually bought at Bandit Camp).
Fly to Small or Large Oil Rig and land cleanly on the helipad.
Gather the required materials, then open the crafting menu (default TAB).
Craft Nailgun and keep it in your inventory or hotbar.

achievements.name: I should buy this Soundtrack
achievements.description: Listen to the Rust soundtrack from a Boom Box for 30 seconds

steps: Play the Rust soundtrack on a Boom Box and listen for 30 seconds.

achievements.name: Big Brother
achievements.description: Watch another player through a CCTV camera

steps: Craft/loot a Computer Station and pair CCTV cameras (monument cams work with the right IDs).
Open the station and view another player through a live camera feed.

achievements.name: Buckle Up
achievements.description: Start a fully repaired car with a full set of T3 engine parts

steps: Fully repair a car and fit a full set of Tier 3 engine parts, then start it.
Hold the gesture/wheel key and select Wave.
Wave at 5 different players (not the same person five times).

achievements.name: Paparazzi
achievements.description: Take a photo of another player

steps: Equip a camera item / photo function available on the wipe.
Take a photograph that includes another player.
Enter the Deep Sea naval zone.
Swim 200 meters without a boat — plan stamina/food carefully.

achievements.name: Sunglasses at Night
achievements.description: Equip a pair of sunglasses after the sun goes down

steps: Obtain sunglasses (loot, vendors, or crafting related to the Sunburn pack items).
Wait until nighttime, then equip the sunglasses.
Join Tutorial Island from the SESSION tab (or use launch options if the button is missing).
Complete every tutorial task, then leave via the boat/menu.
Complete 5 NPC missions (Outpost/Bandit Camp style quests).

achievements.name: Bad Neighbour
achievements.description: Use a megaphone while in another player's Tool Cupboard radius.

steps: Use a megaphone while standing inside another player's Tool Cupboard radius.

achievements.name: Thread the Needle
achievements.description: Land a Minicopter on the Cargo Ship

steps: Locate the moving Cargo Ship monument on the ocean.
Land a Minicopter on its deck without destroying the scrap heli.

achievements.name: Battle Bus
achievements.description: Drive a modular car with 4 passengers

steps: Build or loot a modular car with enough seating modules.
Drive it with 4 passengers aboard (5 people including you).

achievements.name: Arctic Speed
achievements.description: Acquire a snowmobile in an Arctic Research Base

steps: Loot or acquire a snowmobile inside an Arctic Research Base.
Find or craft every instrument type (trumpet, cowbell, etc.).
Play each instrument at least once via the interaction key.

achievements.name: Getting the band together
achievements.description: Join a team of at least 4 people where everyone has instruments equipped

steps: Form a team of 4+ players.
Have every teammate equip an instrument at the same time.

achievements.name: Soaked
achievements.description: Soak another player above the damage threshold using a water gun.

steps: Soak another player past the damage threshold with a water gun.

achievements.name: On the Record
achievements.description: Record another player speaking onto a Cassette.

steps: Craft a Cassette Recorder and blank cassette.
Record another player’s voice while they are speaking nearby.
Go to the Giant Excavator monument with diesel fuel.
Fuel and activate the Excavator.

achievements.name: Cool Kids Club
achievements.description: Be in a team where every team member is riding a Boogie Board or Inner Tube (minimum 4 members)

steps: Form a team of at least 4 players.
Have every member ride a Boogie Board or Inner Tube at the same time.

achievements.name: Liquidator
achievements.description: Get a kill using a water gun.

steps: Craft or loot a Water Gun and fill it.
Get a kill credited with the Water Gun (usually on a low-HP / already weak target — as the game rules allow).

achievements.name: Like Nobody's Watching
achievements.description: Dance near a playing Boom Box on an active Disco Floor.

steps: Place a Boom Box and Disco Floor, start music.
Use a dance gesture while standing on the active Disco Floor near the music.

achievements.name: No Pressure
achievements.description: Get a kill with a super soaker pumped at the lowest pressure.

steps: Kill a player with a super soaker pumped at the lowest pressure setting.

achievements.name: Radical
achievements.description: Splash another player with a Water Pistol while that player is irradiated

steps: Irradiate another player (radiation zones / weapons that apply rads).
Splash them with a Water Pistol while they are still irradiated.

achievements.name: I can no longer see
achievements.description: Stare into a laser light for 30 seconds.

steps: Find a laser light decoration / strobe.
Look directly into it for 30 continuous seconds.

achievements.name: Terror in the Deep
achievements.description: Travel to an underwater lab with a submarine

steps: Obtain a submarine and dive to an Underwater Lab.
Dock/enter the lab after traveling there by sub.

achievements.name: Rust Air
achievements.description: Pilot a Scrap Transport Helicopter with 5 passengers

steps: Pilot a Scrap Transport Helicopter (Chinook-style player scrap heli).
Fly with 5 passengers on board.
Gather the materials for a boat at the coast or a Floating City.
Build your first boat — the achievement unlocks on construction.
Sail or fly out past the normal map border into the Deep Sea zone.
Enter the Deep Sea for the first time.

achievements.name: Party Boat
achievements.description: Dance with 2 other players at the front of the Cargo Ship.

steps: Board the Cargo Ship with two other players.
All three dance at the front/bow area together.

achievements.name: Full Collection
achievements.description: Play an instrument while floating in an Inner Tube while listening to a Boom Box play a radio stream

steps: Float in an Inner Tube, play an instrument, and have a Boom Box playing a radio stream at the same time.

achievements.name: It's Honest Work
achievements.description: Plant a different seed in every slot in a Large Planter Box

steps: Plant a different seed type in every slot of a Large Planter Box.

achievements.name: On Track
achievements.description: Kill 10 Tunnel Dwellers while on a moving work cart

steps: While riding a moving work cart, kill 10 Tunnel Dwellers.
Find coconut food on tropical / island loot.
Eat 10 coconuts (cumulative).
Catch every fish type with a fishing rod (check the fishing guide for missing species).

achievements.name: Pew Pew
achievements.description: Find the hidden Revolver on the Tutorial Island

steps: Join Tutorial Island on an official Facepunch server (use launch options if the tutorial button is missing).
Before finishing tutorial tasks, run to the Lighthouse and check the backside near rocks/water for a hidden Elite Crate.
Open/get close to the crate and loot the Revolver — the achievement unlocks.
warnings: Easy to miss if you rush the tutorial — grab the crate before finishing and leaving the island.

steps: Locate a Floating City ocean monument on the map.
Reach / dock at the Floating City.

achievements.name: Oceans are now battlefields
achievements.description: Hit another boat with a cannon

steps: Mount a cannon on a tugboat / boat that supports it.
Score a hit on another player-owned boat with the cannon.

achievements.name: Treasure ahoy!
achievements.description: Open 5 loot containers on Tropical Islands

steps: On Tropical Islands, open 5 loot containers (crates/caches).

achievements.name: High Roller
achievements.description: Win 3 rounds of poker at Bandit Camp

steps: Go to Bandit Camp’s poker table with enough scrap.
Win 3 poker rounds there.

achievements.name: Death from Above
achievements.description: Kill another player with the MLRS

steps: Find another player with the MLRS in the world (monuments, roads, or biome spawns).
Defeat it with guns, melee, or traps — loot the body if relevant.

achievements.name: Hostile Waters
achievements.description: Start opening a locked crate on a Ghost Ship

steps: Find a Ghost Ship event on the ocean.
Start hacking/opening a locked crate on it.
Open the clan UI and create or accept a clan invite.
Become a clan member.
Find 3 sharks with a speargun in the world (monuments, roads, or biome spawns).
Defeat it with guns, melee, or traps — loot the body if relevant.

achievements.name: Smooth Sailing
achievements.description: Travel 3KM with a companion in a Kayak

steps: Sit in a Kayak with a teammate as companion.
Travel a combined 3 km while sharing the kayak.
Take modular cars to the Junkyard recycler/crusher.
Recycle 10 cars there.

achievements.name: Stolen Goods
achievements.description: Kill a player with a weapon on a stolen PT boat

steps: Find an unattended PT boat and take control of it (stolen, not one you spawned/own).
Use a mounted weapon on that stolen PT boat to kill another player.

achievements.name: Swim with the fishes
achievements.description: Jump off a plank while wearing handcuffs and a hood

steps: Equip handcuffs and a hood.
Jump off a plank (ship plank / pirate-style jump) while wearing both.

achievements.name: New friends
achievements.description: Be a member of a clan with at least 10 members

steps: Join or grow a clan until it has 10+ members.
Remain a member while the roster is at least 10.
Participate in clan-scored activities / events that award clan points.
Earn any clan score contribution for your clan.

achievements.name: Rent is due
achievements.description: Rent a room at the apartment complex

steps: Go to the Apartment complex monument vendor.
Pay scrap to rent a room.

achievements.name: Power Trip
achievements.description: Add a heavy fuse to power plant

steps: At Power Plant, insert a heavy fuse to power the monument.

achievements.name: On target
achievements.description: Kill a player with a mortar

steps: Find a player with a mortar in the world (monuments, roads, or biome spawns).
Defeat it with guns, melee, or traps — loot the body if relevant.

achievements.name: King of the Jungle
achievements.description: Travel 250m with vines in a single life

steps: In a single life, travel 250 m using vines without dying.

achievements.name: Winner Winner
achievements.description: Pet a chicken on the head

steps: Find a chicken.
Interact to pet it on the head.

achievements.name: Space Junk
achievements.description: Bring a satellite out of orbit

steps: Complete the satellite / space event steps available on the wipe.
Bring a satellite out of orbit as the event requires.

achievements.name: No refunds
achievements.description: Make a purchase from the travelling vendor

steps: Find the travelling vendor NPC/vehicle when it spawns.
Buy any item from that vendor.
Find a snake in tropical/jungle areas.
Kill the snake with any weapon.
Find crocodile waters on Tropical Islands.
Let a crocodile kill you (stand in its aggro range).

achievements.name: Pie Hard
achievements.description: Hit a player with a thrown pie

steps: Obtain a throwable pie item.
Throw it and hit another player.

achievements.name: Pen Pal
achievements.description: Drop a note item in another players mailbox

steps: Craft/find a note and drop it into another player's mailbox.
